search|delivery hazards.title: Delivery Hazards
search|delivery hazards.snippet: Overview The Delivery Hazards web application is used for managing hazards, allowing users to create, edit, view and delete hazards - and is used in facilities. The Delivery Hazards web application uses an API (Delivery Hazards Microservice) to do the CRUD (create, read, update and delete) operation and provides user management.
